review: The exact delete-key query is created after the actual field tap and separately recreated after Clear reopens the keyboard. Each predicate still evaluates real exists and isHittable; no cached Boolean or direct field injection is used.

The observed failure AX has exactly one delete key, 54 by 56 points, and the failed call was indexed query collection materialization. A short-circuit firstMatch query directly addresses that observed call without accepting zero-size padding or another key.

All 17 test method bodies compare byte-identical to HEAD, all 153 assertion call sites remain, and the diff retains each existing five-second wait and exact-clear/exact-replacement checks. Keyboard-dismissal collection checks remain untouched.

This is a bounded test-query repair, not evidence of a shipping-product fix. Caching the query does not cache successful visibility or establish a hard wall-clock timeout; XCTest may still wait internally for snapshots.

official_sources.basis: Stops accessibility traversal at the first match and is suitable only when a unique match is known.
Immediately evaluates the query and creates indexed results.

remaining_gate: Actual focused accessibility journey and subsequent complete native acceptance on the sealed integrated candidate.
